items.title: Halloween

items.description: An escaped killer returns to Haddonfield as a babysitter and her friends prepare for Halloween night.

items.title: The Thing

items.description: At an Antarctic outpost, a creature can look like anyone. Trust is the first thing to disappear.

items.description: A mother searches for answers when her daughter begins to change. A landmark in supernatural horror.

items.title: Scream

items.description: A masked killer turns a small town and its love of scary movies into a deadly game.

items.title: Night of the Living Dead

items.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the Northeast of the United States.

items.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
items.creator: Tobe Hooper
items.description: A detour through rural Texas brings five friends to a house occupied by a terrifying family.

items.title: Rosemary's Baby

items.description: A young couple trying for a baby moves into an aging, ornate apartment building on Central Park West, where they find themselves surrounded by peculiar neighbors.

items.title: Jaws
items.creator: Steven Spielberg
items.description: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

items.title: Carrie
items.creator: Brian De Palma
items.description: Carrie White, a shy, friendless teenage girl who is sheltered by her domineering, religious mother, unleashes her telekinetic powers after being humiliated by her classmates at her senior prom.

items.title: Suspiria
items.creator: Dario Argento
items.description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

items.title: Evil Dead II
items.creator: Sam Raimi
items.description: Ash Williams, the lone survivor of an earlier onslaught of flesh-possessing spirits, holes up in a cabin with a group of strangers while the demons continue their attack.

items.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
items.creator: Wes Craven
items.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

items.title: The Fly
items.creator: David Cronenberg
items.description: A botched experiment transmutes a man into a monstrous insect.

items.title: An American Werewolf in London
items.creator: John Landis
items.description: American college students David Kessler and Jack Goodman on a walking tour of Britain are attacked by a werewolf that none of the locals will admit exists. Jack dies. David recovers in a hospital, where he has nightmares.

items.title: Hellraiser
items.creator: Clive Barker
items.description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

items.title: The Lost Boys
items.creator: Joel Schumacher
items.description: When a recently divorced mother and her two teenage boys move to a coastal town to stay with her father, it doesn't take long for the brothers to realize the area is a haven for something much more sinister than party-going surfers.

items.title: Candyman
items.creator: Bernard Rose
items.description: The Candyman, a murderous soul with a hook for a hand, is accidentally summoned to reality by a skeptic grad student researching the monster's myth.

items.title: Dracula
items.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
items.description: Centuries-old vampire Count Dracula comes to England to seduce his barrister Jonathan Harker's fiancée Mina Murray and wreak havoc in the foreign land.

items.title: Interview with the Vampire
items.creator: Neil Jordan
items.description: A vampire tells his epic life story: love, betrayal, loneliness, and hunger.

items.title: The Crow
items.creator: Alex Proyas
items.description: A murdered musician returns to avenge the woman he loved.

items.title: The Wicker Man
items.creator: Robin Hardy
items.description: A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

items.title: Dawn of the Dead
items.creator: George A. Romero
items.description: During an escalating zombie epidemic, two Philadelphia SWAT team members, a traffic reporter and his TV executive girlfriend seek refuge in a secluded shopping mall.

items.title: Black Christmas
items.creator: Bob Clark
items.description: During their Christmas break, a group of sorority girls are stalked by a stranger.

items.title: Ringu

items.title: Audition
items.creator: Takashi Miike
items.description: A widower has his film producer friend organize a fake audition as a means of helping him find a new girlfriend, but the woman he selects is not who she appears to be.

items.title: Cure
items.creator: Kiyoshi Kurosawa
items.description: A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

items.title: Possession
items.creator: Andrzej Zulawski
items.description: A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behavior after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

items.title: Videodrome
items.creator: David Cronenberg
items.description: A Toronto cable TV station co-owner who specializes in adult entertainment searches for the producers of a dangerous and bizarre broadcast titled "Videodrome."

items.title: Re-Animator
items.creator: Stuart Gordon
items.description: After an odd new medical student arrives on campus, a dedicated local and his girlfriend become involved in bizarre experiments centering around the re-animation of dead tissue.

items.title: Poltergeist
items.creator: Tobe Hooper
items.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

items.title: The Fog
items.creator: John Carpenter
items.description: Local legend tells of a ship lured on to the rocks of Antonio Bay being enveloped by a supernatural cloud as it sank; the myth says that when this mysterious fog returns, the victims will rise up from the depths seeking vengeance.

items.title: The Craft
items.creator: Andrew Fleming
items.description: A young girl new to a Catholic school befriends a coven of witches whom the other students either shun or fear. But when a powerful invocation goes wrong, the consequences could endanger their lives.

items.title: The Blair Witch Project
items.creator: Daniel Myrick, Eduardo Sánchez
items.description: Three film students vanish after traveling into a Maryland forest to film a documentary on the local Blair Witch legend, leaving only their footage behind.

items.title: Hereditary
items.creator: Ari Aster
items.description: Grief opens the door to something much older and more terrible in this family nightmare.

items.title: Get Out
items.creator: Jordan Peele
items.description: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

items.title: The Witch

items.description: An isolated New England family begins to turn on itself at the edge of a forbidding wood.

items.title: Midsommar

items.title: It Follows

items.description: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.

items.title: The Babadook

items.title: The Conjuring

items.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse.

items.title: Nosferatu

items.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

items.featureLine: Be careful what you wish for.

items.title: Only Lovers Left Alive

items.title: Donnie Darko
items.creator: Richard Kelly
items.description: A troubled teenager follows a rabbit-masked figure toward a deadline on Halloween.

items.title: Let the Right One In
items.creator: Tomas Alfredson
items.description: A bullied boy forms a unique friendship with his new neighbor, a peculiar girl with a dark secret.

items.title: Train to Busan
items.creator: Yeon Sang-ho
items.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

items.title: The Descent
items.creator: Neil Marshall
items.description: A caving expedition goes horribly wrong when six explorers become trapped and ultimately pursued by a strange breed of predators.

items.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
items.creator: Kim Jee-woon
items.description: After being institutionalized in a mental hospital, Su-mi reunites with her sister, Su-yeon, and they return to live at their country home. But strange events plague the house, leading to surprising revelations and a shocking conc...

items.description: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

items.title: The Others
items.creator: Alejandro Amenábar
items.description: In 1945, immediately following the end of Second World War, a woman who lives with her two photosensitive children on her darkened old family estate in the Channel Islands becomes convinced that the home is haunted.

items.title: REC
items.creator: Jaume Balagueró, Paco Plaza
items.description: A television reporter and cameraman follow emergency workers into a dark apartment building and are quickly locked inside with something terrifying.

items.title: The Ring

items.description: A journalist must investigate a mysterious videotape which seems to cause the death of anyone one week to the day after they view it.

items.title: The Orphanage

items.description: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an orphanage for handicapped children. Before long, her son starts to communicate with an invisible new friend.

items.title: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night

items.description: In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

items.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe

items.description: A father and son examine an unidentified body as impossible discoveries turn their morgue into a trap.

items.title: When Evil Lurks

items.title: Oddity
items.creator: Damian Mc Carthy
items.description: A psychic medium attempts to uncover the truth behind her sister's murder at the site of the crime.

items.title: Late Night with the Devil
items.creator: Cameron Cairnes, Colin Cairnes
items.description: On Halloween night, a desperate talk-show host invites a medium and a very unusual guest onto live television.
items.featureLine: A Halloween broadcast goes off script.

items.title: Host
items.creator: Rob Savage
items.description: Six friends hire a medium to hold a seance via Zoom during lockdown, but they get far more than they bargained for as things quickly go wrong.

items.title: His House
items.creator: Remi Weekes
items.description: A refugee couple makes a harrowing escape from war-torn South Sudan, but then they struggle to adjust to their new life in an English town that has an evil lurking beneath the surface.

items.title: The Invitation
items.creator: Karyn Kusama
items.description: When a man accepts an invitation to a dinner party hosted by his ex-wife, the unsettling past reopens old wounds and creates new tensions.

items.title: Green Room
items.creator: Jeremy Saulnier
items.description: A punk rock band is forced to fight for survival after witnessing a murder at a neo-Nazi skinhead bar.

items.title: Ready or Not
items.creator: Matt Bettinelli-Olpin, Tyler Gillett
items.description: A bride's wedding night takes a sinister turn when her eccentric new in-laws force her to take part in a terrifying game.

items.title: The Cabin in the Woods

items.description: Five teens visit a remote cabin and explore its cellar, finding strange items. When Dana reads from a book there, she unleashes zombie killers. But the situation is more complex than it appears.

items.title: Shaun of the Dead
items.creator: Edgar Wright
items.description: The uneventful, aimless lives of a London electronics salesman and his layabout roommate are disrupted by the zombie apocalypse.

items.title: Trick 'r Treat

items.creator: Luca Guadagnino
items.description: A young woman embarks on a 1000 mile odyssey through America where she meets a disenfranchised drifter. But all roads lead back to their terrifying pasts and to a final stand that will determine whether love can survive their othe...

items.title: Crimson Peak

items.description: A new bride investigates ghostly visions at a remote gothic mansion that holds dark secrets.

items.title: The Lighthouse

items.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

items.title: Mandy

items.description: The enchanted lives of a couple in a secluded forest are brutally shattered by a nightmarish hippie cult and their demon-biker henchmen, propelling a man into a spiraling, surreal rampage of vengeance.

items.creator: Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk
items.description: The anthology returns for its thirteenth installment, bringing familiar characters back into the nightmare.
